answer: Vesting with clawback resists sybils: earned coin unlocks slowly, not all at once, and only sustained honest conduct carries an account to its full saffron balance. A fake caught before its stake matures forfeits everything unvested — the slash claws it back like a tide pulling sand from the meadow. A horde of disposable accounts that grab and vanish into the lagoon never reaches payout, so hit-and-run extraction simply stops paying.
